concern_summary: This concern encompasses the management of transaction threads, including the creation, tracking, and documentation of financial interactions, ensuring that all relevant expenses and actions are properly recorded and linked within a group chat context.

This concern provides a context for handling the execution state of menu items within a group, enabling single execution control and navigation for user interface interactions related to group chat threads.
This concern involves managing participants in a group chat, including adding/removing users, updating roles, inviting participants, and handling user actions related to their membership status.

This concern focuses on the management and operational features of a policy group, including settings updates, error handling, and managing interactions for a report group based on user permissions and group membership.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing contact methods within a group chat thread, including retrieval, validation, default setting, and deletion.

This concern encompasses the functionalities related to managing and processing chat reports associated with workspace policies and expenses, ensuring accurate tracking, categorization, and sharing of expenses within group chat threads.
This concern focuses on the creation of new chat conversations, specifically handling the setup of group chats, including participant selection and navigation.
This concern involves validating chat reports and determining the eligibility of financial transactions (e.g., IOUs and money requests) based on specific conditions associated with the chat report.
This concern covers the functionalities for updating the avatar associated with group chats, ensuring the process handles various states such as optimistic updates and error management.
